claims.claim: Julian of Eclanum (c. 386–c. 455); bishop of Eclanum; deposed/exiled 418 for refusing to condemn Pelagius.
Literary feud with Augustine ran 419–428; most learned/systematic Pelagian; works survive via Augustine's quotations (Opus imperfectum left unfinished at Augustine's death).
SCOPE: six books To Florus + earlier fragments + letter material, each with source locator.
